result.topic_en: Calculations on differential expressions with antisymmetric coefficients $a_{\iota,\iota'}$ divided by partial derivatives of a function $f$, the integrability-type condition $\frac{\partial f}{\partial x_{\iota''}}a_{\iota,\iota'}+\dots = f\,b_{\iota,\iota',\iota''}$, and the special case of four variables where $a_{i,k}$ is expressed through $x_i$ and $\xi_i$, with a binomial-coefficient count for general $n$.
